nodes.title: 参考载入事项
widgets_values:
通过限制视频的最长边来减少视频尺寸可以大幅度提高clip视觉编码速度与视频生成速度，并且降低显存消耗，酌情进行调整，但是由于qkv分块的存在不用过于担心爆显存，调大分辨率也没事。

限制设为0时代表不缩小分辨率。

裁剪视频范围应按官方条件限制为最低两秒，最长15秒。

nodes.title: 启动参数
widgets_values:
推荐运行环境（参数名称可能因启动器和 ComfyUI 版本不同）：

• 启用 cudaMallocAsync 异步显存分配器  
• 启用异步权重卸载，建议约 2 个传输流  
• 保持 Pinned Memory／锁页内存开启，容量交由 ComfyUI 按系统内存自动计算  
• 启用智能显存管理或 DynamicVRAM  
• 在启动器或 NVIDIA CUDA 驱动设置中优先禁止系统内存兜底，避免显存不足后无提示地进入极慢状态  
• VAE 优先使用 GPU，显存确实不足时再改用 CPU  

以上属于推荐环境而非节点硬性依赖。请根据本机 ComfyUI、启动器、显卡显存和驱动版本核对对应设置，勿直接照搬其他整合包的参数名称。

nodes.title: Sigma Shift与分块加速提醒事项
widgets_values:
注意力加速切记按照自己的显卡选择，20系选择sm75系列，这个是为了20系专门预编译好的。新架构选择sm80+，ck是通用的，或者选择existing然后在前面自行连接kjsage等注意力加速节点。

注意力选择中ck质量最佳、sol其次、sla一般，但是速度会大幅度提升，高负载情况下尤为明显。在1.0MP分辨率、10秒、4步lora、参考图生视频参数下分别为620秒、442秒、350秒。使用hybird混合注意力可平衡速度与质量。

对于2080ti 22g显卡三个参数保持8192即可，显存未占满并不会影响速度。如果在超高参数下遇到爆显存的情况（如2.0 10秒）可以开启输出显存保护，默认关闭，开启可能会导致降速。

nodes.title: 导出事项
widgets_values:
该选项可以自动将工作流内置保存在视频中，后续通过该节点生成的视频可以拖动到提示词载入节点处来快速导入当时使用的提示词。

注意保存的工作流视频如果通过微信等方式发送会导致被压缩而失去内置工作流。使用仅视频时将不会保存工作流。

还可以使用视频+工作流png来保存一张带有第一帧视频图片的工作流图片，占用存储小可以当做可视化工作流模板卡。

nodes.title: Lora注意事项
widgets_values:
对于目前的测试来说，larryvrh的minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600对于真实人物的油腻感较轻，更为自然，但是需要使用这个作者的专用lora加载器加载该lora，否则画面会模糊崩坏。也可以使用网盘中的minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_comfyui_T8-convert转化版直接用comfyui的lora加载器进行加载，无需使用特殊lora加载器。

之前使用v4_step600日志中的报错是由于该lora匹配完整版模型，使用剪枝模型时由于部分模块无法对应产生报错，最新版已经兼容该问题。

Sigma Shift需要根据不同lora设定的进行改动，大部分情况4步lora为 6 / 3 ,8步为 12 / 3 ，绕过节点即可恢复默认 12 / 3 ，以实际lora公布参数为主。fast h3 v2模型需要使用vsa注意力，无需开启lora，sigma需要调整为10 / 3.

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult woman, the first uploaded character sheet. Use the unobscured facial close-up to preserve her facial identity. Retain her long wavy black hair, hoop earrings, black halter-neck backless gown with a thigh-high slit, black fingerless gloves, waist-mounted identification badge, and black pointed heels. Her fighting performance emphasizes evasive footwork, compact counters, and leverage.
<Subject 2> is the adult female cyborg, the second uploaded character sheet. Use the unobscured facial close-up to preserve her facial identity. Retain her dark partially tied-back hair, fine facial mechanical seams, white and orange-gold armor, exposed dark mechanical joints, and metallic ear assemblies. Extend the established armor design consistently to the unseen lower body. Her fighting performance emphasizes powerful punches, knee strikes, and committed kicks.

summary:
[reference generation] An exactly ten-second photorealistic sewer fight between <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>, filmed as one continuous moving shot. Varied choreography progresses through a punching combination, elbow counter, knee strike, low sweep, spinning kick, wrist control, and a leverage-based takedown with a recovery roll. Fast push-ins and pullbacks follow the changing fighting distance, with one brief bullet-time orbit during a narrowly avoided kick. Reference images define character appearance only.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the referenced face, hair, gown, gloves, earrings, badge, and shoes. Her new combat movements do not alter her identity or costume design.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the referenced face, hair, facial mechanical details, armor construction, color distribution, and ear assemblies. Lower-body armor is a coherent extension of the visible design.
Exclude reference-sheet typography, gray face-obscuring squares, borders, duplicated views, and studio backgrounds. Neither picture is a first-frame or composition anchor.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic cinematic action, 16:9, exactly ten seconds, one uninterrupted take. Choreography is fast, varied, and causally connected: each defense creates the next attack. Every strike has a readable trajectory and reaction, with grounded balance rather than weightless acrobatics.

[Shot 1] Inside a dim concrete sewer, <Subject 1> starts left foreground in her black slit gown and gloves; <Subject 2> faces her right midground in white-and-orange armor. Their referenced faces remain distinct. Shallow water covers rough concrete footing. Corroded pipes line the walls; cyan maintenance lights and a weak amber backlight reveal faces, limbs, and reflections without brightening the tunnel excessively.

During 00:00.000–00:01.600, the camera rapidly pushes from a medium-wide view into a waist-up two-shot. <Subject 2> advances with a left jab followed immediately by a right cross. <Subject 1> parries the jab, slips outside the cross, and answers with a short right elbow toward the shoulder. <Subject 2> turns her armored upper arm into the elbow. Sharp glove movement, a metallic knock, and quick splashes punctuate the combination.

During 00:01.600–00:03.000, <Subject 2> converts the close contact into a driving right knee toward the abdomen. <Subject 1> braces both forearms against the rising thigh, pivots off its line, and releases immediately. As the knee lowers, she drops her center of gravity and sends a low right-leg sweep toward the supporting ankle. The camera curves laterally and pulls back to reveal both fighters’ feet. <Subject 2> makes a compact hop over the sweep and lands with a broad splash.

During 00:03.000–00:04.300, <Subject 1> retracts her sweeping leg and rises. <Subject 2> uses the landing to initiate a turning right back kick toward her upper torso, looking over her shoulder before extending. The camera tracks the rotation from outside the kick’s path, keeping attacker, target, and planted foot visible. <Subject 1> bends her knees and shifts diagonally backward, narrowly clearing the armored heel.

During 00:04.300–00:05.400, the heel passes just in front of <Subject 1>’s shoulder. Ramp into extreme slow motion for this single near miss. The camera smoothly orbits sixty degrees with a slight push-in, revealing the gap between armor and black fabric through genuine spatial parallax. The kicking leg continues extending gradually; hair, skirt folds, and airborne droplets drift rather than freeze. Stretched water noise and a subdued mechanical whine replace the sharp impacts.

During 00:05.400–00:07.500, snap back to full speed. <Subject 2> retracts the kick, plants her foot, and turns back with a reaching left punch. <Subject 1> redirects the wrist, captures that forearm with both hands, and steps outside the attacking arm. <Subject 2> bends her elbow and drives forward to break the control. The camera follows laterally, widening to preserve their hands, hips, and footing.

During 00:07.500–00:10.000, <Subject 1> yields to that forward pressure, pivots beside <Subject 2>, and blocks her advancing ankle while drawing the captured arm diagonally down. Momentum carries <Subject 2> into a low sideways trip rather than an overhead lift. She lands on her armored side, immediately rolls through, and rises onto one knee facing her opponent. <Subject 1> releases before the fall and steps into guard. The camera dips with the takedown, then retreats into a clear two-person view as water slaps down. End with both ready to continue, without a pose hold or fade.

overall_soundscape:
Low flowing water, irregular drips, and short concrete-tunnel reverberation continue throughout. Synchronize distinct sounds to each technique: fast punch swishes, a hard elbow-on-armor knock, a muted knee interception, scraping water during the sweep, a heavy landing splash, mechanical rotation during the kick, glove friction during wrist control, and a deep armored impact during the trip. Brief exertion breaths, no dialogue. Stretch and attenuate sound only during 00:04.300–00:05.400; restore crisp combat transients immediately afterward.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained fast industrial percussion rhythm with low bass supports the fight without covering contact sounds. Percussion briefly drops out during the bullet-time interval, leaving a low sustained tone, then returns sharply with normal-speed action. No vocals.
